from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u023/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-ff616c6f.py'
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_spans = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds)-1) if row_bounds[i]+1 < row_bounds[i+1]]
    col_spans = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds)-1) if col_bounds[i]+1 < col_bounds[i+1]]
    sep_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
    counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for r0,r1 in row_spans for r in range(r0,r1) for c0,c1 in col_spans for c in range(c0,c1))
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker_colors = [color for color in counts if color != background and color not in sep_colors]
    marker = marker_colors[0]
    out = [[background for _ in col_spans] for _ in row_spans]
    for ri,(r0,r1) in enumerate(row_spans):
        for ci,(c0,c1) in enumerate(col_spans):
            for r in range(r0,r1):
                for c in range(c0,c1):
                    if grid[r][c] == marker and ((r+1 < r1 and grid[r+1][c] == marker) or (c+1 < c1 and grid[r][c+1] == marker)):
                        out[ri][ci] = 1
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
print(program_path)
